# Quest Helper contribution guidance

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before assisting with contributions.
Support the human developer with review, existing examples, formatting, compilation debugging, and Git assistance.
Follow existing helper patterns and keep changes focused.

Before opening a PR, including a draft, marking it ready, or publishing further changes to an existing PR, present
the final diff and validation results and wait for the contributor's explicit confirmation for that version.
Use the documented draft exception only when the contributor acknowledges the testing gaps and requests that draft.
Never complete personal-review checkboxes or claim that a person reviewed or tested the changes on their behalf.
